15. export async function createWorkFile(doc: TextDocument): Promise<WorkFile> {
16.   // Use a real file if posibble
17.   if (doc.uri.scheme === 'file' && !doc.isDirty) {
18.     return { path: doc.uri.fsPath, cleanup: () => Promise.resolve() }
19.   }
20. 
21.   const text = doc.getText()
22.   const tmpFileName = `.marp-vscode-tmp-${nanoid()}`
23.   const createCleanup = (target: string) => () => promiseUnlink(target)
24. 
25.   // Try to create tmp file to the same directory as a document
26.   const sameDirTmpPath = path.join(path.dirname(doc.uri.fsPath), tmpFileName)
27. 
28.   try {
29.     await promiseWriteFile(sameDirTmpPath, text)
30.     return { path: sameDirTmpPath, cleanup: createCleanup(sameDirTmpPath) }
31.   } catch (e) {
32.     // no ops
33.   }
34. 
35.   // If it fails, try to create to the root of workspace
36.   const documentWorkspace = workspace.getWorkspaceFolder(doc.uri)
37. 
38.   if (documentWorkspace?.uri.scheme === 'file') {
39.     const workspaceDir = documentWorkspace.uri.fsPath
40.     const workspaceDirTmpPath = path.join(workspaceDir, tmpFileName)
41. 
42.     try {
43.       await promiseWriteFile(workspaceDirTmpPath, text)
44.       return {
45.         path: workspaceDirTmpPath,
46.         cleanup: createCleanup(workspaceDirTmpPath),
47.       }
48.     } catch (e) {
49.       // no ops
50.     }
51.   }
52. 
53.   // If it fails, create to OS specific tmp directory
54.   const tmpPath = path.join(tmpdir(), tmpFileName)
55. 
56.   await promiseWriteFile(tmpPath, text)
57.   return { path: tmpPath, cleanup: createCleanup(tmpPath) }
58. }

60. export async function createConfigFile(
61.   target: TextDocument
62. ): Promise<WorkFile> {
63.   const tmpFileName = `.marp-vscode-cli-conf-${nanoid()}.json`
64.   const tmpPath = path.join(tmpdir(), tmpFileName)
65.   const cliOpts = await marpCoreOptionForCLI(target)
66. 
67.   await promiseWriteFile(tmpPath, JSON.stringify(cliOpts))
68.

70.     path: tmpPath,

72.       await Promise.all([
73.         promiseUnlink(tmpPath),

75.       ])

77.   }
78. }

80. export default async function runMarpCli(...argv: string[]): Promise<void> {
81.   console.info(`Execute Marp CLI: ${argv.join(' ')}`)
82. 
83.   const { marpCli, CLIError, CLIErrorCode } = await import(
84.     '@marp-team/marp-cli'
85.   )
86.   const { CHROME_PATH } = process.env
87. 
88.   let exitCode: number
89. 
90.   try {
91.     process.env.CHROME_PATH =
92.       marpConfiguration().get<string>('chromePath') || CHROME_PATH
93. 
94.     exitCode = await marpCli(argv)
95.   } catch (e) {
96.     console.error(e)
97.

99.       e instanceof CLIError &&
100.       e.errorCode === CLIErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_CHROMIUM
101.     ) {
102.       const chromium =
103.         process.platform === 'linux'
104.           ? ' or [Chromium](https://www.chromium.org/)'
105.           : ''
106. 
107.       throw new MarpCLIError(
108.         `It requires to install [Google Chrome](https://www.google.com/chrome/)${chromium} for exporting.`
109.       )
110.     }
111. 
112.     throw e
113.   } finally {
114.     process.env.CHROME_PATH = CHROME_PATH
115.   }
116. 
117.   if (exitCode !== 0) {
118.     throw new MarpCLIError(
119.       `Marp CLI throwed unexpected error with exit code ${exitCode}.`
120.     )
121.   }
122. }
